name: Lovense Max 2
summary: App-connected vibrating and air-pump contraction sleeve built primarily for two-way couples sync (especially paired with Lovense Nora) and cam interaction.
ranking_rationale: Strongest for bi-directional Lovense partner sync—motion/pressure data talks directly to a partner's toy—though less mechanical than true linear strokers like The Handy.

pricing.notes: Check official store for current pricing; replacement TPE sleeves sold separately.

pros: True two-way partner sync pairs smoothly with Lovense Nora or Lush
Adjustable air-vent suction plus internal contraction ribs
Easy open-ended TPE sleeve removal for rinsing and drying
cons: Uses vibration + air-bladder squeeze rather than full up-and-down stroke mechanics
Bulkier body weighs heavily during longer solo sessions
Audible pump motor at higher contraction settings

image.alt: Lovense Max 2 logo and brand card

facts.value: Bluetooth + Lovense Remote + two-way partner sync
